findings.obligation: S1 P1 E2: a Cloud whole-history read still holding fewer entries than Jira counts stays marked as not holding its whole history
findings.remediation: Serve the Cloud partial changelog page as Jira pages it: isLast false with startAt, maxResults and total consistent with the two values returned. The current fixture returns two of four values with isLast true, which a real Cloud page never does. Verdict then depends on the connector reading isLast, not on the count. Keep the whole-read fixture as one complete page.

Use the partial re-read's longer history so a replacement is visible. Or amend the acceptance row through its owner. Until then the row is claimed Tested but unobserved.
